7/ What Can You Do To Stay Safe? ✔️

Make sure to wash your hands regularly 🧼

Make sure to sterilize the areas where people most have contact, which include doors, light switches, and many other things that come into contact with many people.🧴

nodes.author: Drdoks
nodes.text:
Do not go to many people in a crowded area; if possible, avoid doing so at peak times. 🚷

If your health is not well, make sure to stay at your residence.
